title: Orbit 2022 — Art Programme
excerpt: Curating the art programme for Orbit Festival 2022, with works by SouRCe, re:gen and c55h72mgn4o5.
description:
For the 2022 edition of Orbit Festival I curated the art programme, bringing three installations into the festival grounds: SouRCe, re:gen and c55h72mgn4o5.
> Rather than designing the light myself that year, my work was the selection and the staging — choosing works that would hold their own among the trees and the crowd, and placing them so each found its own space in the festival.
credits: Curator: Jaco Schilp. Works by SouRCe, re:gen and c55h72mgn4o5. Presented at Orbit Festival 2022.
